Before your shift

Getting started

This handbook covers processing a lab order end to end: seeing what's waiting, entering results (or uploading a scanned report), and finalizing it so the doctor and patient can see it. Every screenshot is the real system.

  1. 1Open the hospital system in your browser and go to the address given to you by the Admin team.
  2. 2Type the Username and Password your Admin created for you.
  3. 3Click Login. You land on your Lab Dashboard automatically.
🔒Forgot your password? Only an Admin can reset it — ask them directly.
👁 What you'll see — the login screen

Status colours at a glance

Each lab test carries one of these statuses.

Upcoming — ordered, but still waiting on the patient's bill payment
Confirmed — billed and ready for you to process
Completed — results are saved and visible to the doctor
1

Your lab dashboard

Lab Dashboard — every test ordered for today, split into two tables.

  1. 1Confirmed Lab Test Orders is your work list — these are billed and ready to process.
  2. 2Upcoming Lab Test Orders (collapsed by default) shows tests that are ordered but not yet billed — nothing to do here yet.
  3. 3Use Search or Filter Date to find a specific patient.
Once billed, the green Complete Report button appears when results are ready
2

Enter results

Click View Lab Order on a confirmed row.

  1. 1Expand each test's section to see its fields, reference range, and units.
  2. 2Type the measured value into the Result box for each field.
  3. 3Click Save Report Details, review how many fields are filled, then Confirm & Save.
One field entered for this test
Confirms exactly how many fields you've filled before saving
💡You can save with some fields still empty and come back to finish later — saving never erases a value you already entered.
3

Upload a report file

For tests where you have a scanned report or external printout instead of typing values in.

  1. 1Click the yellow Upload Lab Report button on the patient's row.
  2. 2Choose the test and attach the file (PDF or image).
  3. 3Once a file is uploaded for a test, manual entry for that test is disabled — the file is the result.
⚠Uploading is per test — if a patient has several tests, you can mix typed results and uploaded files across them.
4

Complete the report

Once every test has a result or an uploaded file, a green button appears.

  1. 1Click Complete Report in the patient's row.
  2. 2Review the summary and the live report-slip preview.
  3. 3Optionally click Email Results PDF to send it to the patient directly.
  4. 4Click Confirm & Complete Report — this finalizes it for the doctor and patient to see.
The green button only appears once every test is ready
5

Report history

Patient Lab Reports in the left menu — every completed visit, searchable.

  1. 1Search by name, ID, test, or doctor, or filter by date.
  2. 2Click View Details to see the full report, or Email to resend it.
A completed visit with every test it covered

Getting help

If a screen looks different from this guide, or an action doesn't behave as described, stop and contact your Admin or IT support before continuing. This guide was captured directly from the system on 8 September 2026 using a training patient record; nothing here is a real patient's data.
